Up the branch with first Giant Oracle Envoy is the second one grouped with a Large Oracle Envoy and two Oracle Envoy 's. Alternative option : From the Haligtree Town Site of Grace , go back and up the ladder, run onto the wide branch and stop before the first two Scarlet Rot Miranda Sprouts (killing them helps). There should be a part of the branch that sticks up slightly right where the first sprout was, with a disc shape facing away from the Giant Oracle Envoy above. Walking into it or casting spells should not move your character from here, so casting spells with an arc and an explosion such as Cannon of Haima while aiming straight up will kill the first Envoy and prevent the stress of making it onto the same branch. Then it is trivial to kill the second Giant Oracle Envoy and its accompanying Large Oracle Envoy.

All other Haligtree Knights, regardless of if they wield this Shield, will not drop it. To reach the Knight, go to the Drainage Channel Site of Grace, head outside and follow the roots on your left. Drop down onto the first support beam (a flying buttress) that slopes down to the right. Halfway down the buttress, there is a branch to the left that you need to drop down to. Cross the branch and jump/fall onto another buttress. From here, you can fall to the ground directly while taking some fall damage, or jump to the church balcony first and drop from there. The knight can be found sitting underneath the buttress near its base. Alternatively, from the Haligtree Roots Site of Grace, turn around and go up the elevator. Once you reach the top, run straight until you're outside the Church. Then turn right, and right again once you get past the corner of the building to find the knight.

269267456.loc: Found at Raya Lucaria Academy . [ Map Link ]; Closest Site of Grace: Debate Parlor.; From the Site of Grace, go North. Upon reaching the courtyard, turn left and climb the ruined staircase, then climb the second staircase where 2 mages are shooting at you. When you reach the door, turn left and jump over the railing - behind you is a mage and a shortcut 1-way door. Climb the stairs and turn left, then jump over the railing again. Turn left and go to the edge, there's a gap. Jump it and follow the roof forward and to the right. You will enter a tower with a wooden floor and a hole in it. There are wooden platforms to drop down. The Crystallized Crab is on one of these platforms. Look for the Crystallized Crab inside the hole and kill it, and it will reward you with the crown.

270345456.loc: On a rocky ledge at Volcano Manor , Altus Plateau . To reach the Crimson Tear Scarab, start from the Temple of Eiglay site of grace. Route A: If you have activated the wooden elevator in the tower to the north, ride it to the top. After the elevator reaches the top, exit the room via the doorway to the northeast. Look over the railing to the south; there is a ledge below with a corpse. Route B: Take the stone lift south of the Temple of Eiglay grace. Walk out to the balcony, and jump down to a rocky ledge to the east. Follow the path past Burning Slugs up to the top. Head northwest to the nearest tower, where an Abductor Virgin appears. Jump into the open window of the tower. Exit the room through a door to the right. Right before the Man-Serpent wielding a burning sword, look over the railing to the south to see a ledge with a corpse. The Crimson Tear Scarab can be looted from that corpse. 1073955824.loc: Miquella's Haligtree near Haligtree Town site of grace [ Elden Ring Map ]; From the Haligtree Town site of grace, ascend the eastern ladder and run up the large branch past the scarlet rot flowers and avoiding the bubbles from the Giant Envoy behind you. Jump down to the left to a small branch from some fungi. From there approach and kill the Giant Envoy that was above you. Then continue upwards to the east where one Giant Envoy, one large Envoy, and two envoys guard the ashes.; Unless you want to watch your back when you run from the Haligtree Town site of grace, I suggest running to the ashes from the start of the area. When you are running towards the second grace, you will start getting attacked from the big Oracle Envoy. Before the first attack reaches you, you can fall or jump to a lower branch on the right side. Follow that branch going upwards and you will find the ashes to the right being guarded by four Oracle Envoys. Two small ones, one medium, and a large one.
